schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (66 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints 46 twice (two-mark run: q046, q046b); 68 questions. Answer side 1-25, unnumbered match block (8 rows), 27-46, '46 (Repeated).' (pairs with q046b by printed label and order), 47-66; q067 (draw) no key. No shifts. Difficulty per question: easy 45, average 11, difficult 11, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 97 (heading, LO 9 bullets) 98-101; A pdf 191-195.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with appropriate answers (easy)' q26 (8 rows); s5 one mark q27-41 vsa; s6 two marks q42-50 incl. q046b sa; s7 three marks q51-60 sa; s8 four marks q61-67 la.

TOPICS (ruling R-E7): EVS map v1 evs-4-24 sections s00 Introduction (not tickable: the cloud's journey and landforms), s01 Air, s02 Water, s03 Soil, s04 Weather and Climate. One clear section -> that section ('content', 'high'); landform/journey questions (intro content) and mixed ones -> all four tickable sections ('content', 'low'); s00 never used. Mapping listed in the unit summary.

q54 prints no difficulty tag (three-mark section header untagged) -> 'no difficulty tag'. q67 tag '(hard)' -> difficult (word map). q61 key opens 'The cloud saw:' -> heading, not a step; its closing line 'These are all natural resources …' is printed indented under the last bullet with no full stop before it -> its own line (not joined). q64 'Example: …' printed inside the Climate bullet after a full stop -> kept as a second line of that bullet.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_24.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
